title: Make the Gemini CLI adapters work on a real session
desc: Found testing WB-61 against Gemini CLI 0.61.0: (1) wb hooks install gemini writes "python" "wb_hook.py" ...; Gemini runs hooks through PowerShell on Windows, where a quoted command needs the & call operator, so the hook fails and the edit is allowed. (2) wb run --agent gemini exits 55 in a folder Gemini has not trusted, and in an untrusted folder Gemini ignores project hooks; GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true fixes both. (3) headless Gemini throws on any tool that needs confirmation, and auto_edit leaves the shell needing it, so a session cannot run wb; allow exactly the wb invocation through a --policy file instead of yolo. (4) parse_gemini ignores the session_id Gemini reports.
